arguments.question: For ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA over 21/63 sessions, assess dated U.S. monetary-policy/rates and macro-risk channels using the seeded Fed/FRED and fixed SPY/IWM/HYG context. Identify transmission mechanisms (discount rates, capex/advertising/semiconductor demand, credit risk), distinguish observed data from scenarios, and stop after the latest relevant policy/rates observations; do not infer an allocation or calibrated forecast.
arguments.decision_impact: Establishes whether a common macro/rates regime could dominate issuer-specific catalysts and frames cross-watchlist downside review conditions.
